Subject: Supplier registration + PO acceptance fields for Redwood Inference

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this—we're getting Redwood set up as a supplier in Gridline's AP system ahead of the pilot rollout. To complete registration we need a couple of things so our procurement and tax teams can validate payment routing and VAT handling: 

- Legal entity name as it should appear on our PO and remit instructions
- Registered VAT/Tax ID for the billing entity (EU VAT if applicable)
- Company address for invoice header and tax residency
- Bank remit details (Beneficiary name, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC) and whether payments should be routed via our GBP/EUR/CHF accounts
- A sample invoice (PDF) and the invoice XML/CSV mapping if available (we use a PO_NUMBER field to match POs on import)
- Confirmation if you accept split-PO line matching (we sometimes send multiple PO lines to a single invoice)

I've attached our Gridline PO template for reference (gridline_po_template.xlsx) and the supplier portal onboarding checklist. Can you also confirm whether Redwood requires VAT reverse-charge handling or self-billing documentation? Our tax ops flagged this as a special case for cross-border services.

If easier, we can schedule a quick screen share with tax/AP to walk through the mapping.

Thanks—once we have the packet complete I can create the supplier record and issue the first PO for your test invoice.

Best,
Elena Petrova
Senior AP Analyst, Gridline Systems

Mina — thanks, this is very helpful. Quick clarifications from tax and our integration team: 

- For the PO mapping we need PO_NUMBER to arrive in XML as <OrderReference><PO_NUMBER> or as a top-level attribute PO_NUMBER in the CSV extract. Line matching would use <LineReference><PO_LINE_ID>. I'll attach the XML spec.
- We do require the VAT ID placed in the supplier record and on the invoice header for EU cross-border services. If you want reverse-charge, please send the signed self-billing addendum; until we receive it our default is to process invoices with VAT.
- For bank routing: please also provide whether you accept payments via our virtual IBAN program (faster EUR rails).
- Portal activation: I'll create a supplier portal user for "Redwood Inference, Inc." and send the activation link. The portal supports SFTP and EDI test drops; we can schedule a test invoice upload after registration.

I've attached: gridline_po_template.xlsx (with PO mapping tab), gridline_invoice_xml_spec.docx (docx). For agreements we typically handle self-billing as a separate DocuSign envelope — link: https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/sign/EE3A9F

Can you confirm whether Redwood wants us to enable virtual IBAN routing? Also, please provide a sample XML (or CSV) invoice payload that matches your system so our integrators can validate the import mapping.

Regards,
Elena
Senior AP Analyst, Gridline Systems
attachments: gridline_invoice_xml_spec.docx (docx)
